notes: These scenarios must be captured from the current productive CustomTkinter app before V2 cutover.
Hand-written examples under tests/fixtures/golden_examples only validate normalization helpers.

scenarios.description: Single LAS/LAZ upload converted to Potree output.
Multi-cloud upload with mixed Potree and COPC sources.
Horizontal CRS plus vertical CRS/datum metadata.
Upload from an already converted Potree folder.
Project duplication preserves source metadata and creates a new active clone.
Project deletion updates active/disabled indexes and deleted_projects.json.
Rename updates project and pointcloud metadata without reactivating disabled links.
Single pointcloud replacement preserves project link and updates one cloud entry.
Complete multi-cloud replacement updates pointclouds and orphan cleanup contract.
Disabled project/link state remains stable across rename and replace.
